falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low (4,800 area) would invalidate the 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that pattern held above this level; it would signal a lower low structure, not a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic exceeding that bottom's stress level, breaking the pattern's volatility signature and suggesting capitulation rather than bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y by >0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with spread near -15bps; deepening inversion beyond -50bps signals recessionary repricing that overrides the bottom pattern, indicating fundamental deterioration not present in the matched pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
